guitar.guitaristsText: John Lennon / George Harrison / Paul McCartney
guitar.modelsText: Rickenbacker 325/360-12, Gretsch, Epiphone Casino, Gibson J-160E
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: well documented across multiple guitars and eras — Lennon's Rickenbacker 325/Casino, Harrison's Gretsch/Rickenbacker 360-12, McCartney mainly bass (Hofner) with some guitar use.
guitar.notes: Original entry reasonable as a summary across three members and many guitars; kept as-is.

tone.target: dry jangly Vox-style rhythm with slight edge
tone.profile: dry jangly Vox-style rhythm with slight edge
tone.summary: The chain uses a Boost for initial punch, followed by the AC30 TB amp model paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cabinet. Compression enhances pick attack, while Chorus is avoided and Room provides subtle ambience.

rig.name: The Beatles - Ticket To Ride - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain clarity for jangly rhythm playing.
Enhance pick attack and provide initial punch for the jangly rhythm.
blocks.gap: A dedicated clean boost (like a simple tube screamer model) would be ideal, but Boost serves to increase output level and brightness.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone clean and focused on natural breakup rather than heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: No dedicated light overdrive model is required; the AC30 amp model handles the necessary 'slight edge' naturally. Using a DST module here would muddy the chime.

blocks.purpose: Emulate the classic Vox AC30 sound required for 60s pop jangle and bright chime.
Provide a classic British cabinet sound that complements the AC30 model.
blocks.gap: While US 2x12 was suggested by gear clues, UK Vintage 4x12 is more versatile for pop/rock and pairs well with the AC30 tone.

blocks.purpose: Brighten the high end (chime) and tighten the low-mids to ensure a jangly, defined rhythm tone.
No wah effect is needed for this specific jangly rhythm tone.
Avoid chorus as per the 'corrections' list to maintain a dry, tight pop sound.
blocks.gap: The user explicitly requested dropping Chorus. This module is bypassed/inactive.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle rhythmic depth without sounding overly processed or distracting from the main rhythm.
blocks.gap: A very short, clean delay is needed. Digital Delay provides this control.

blocks.purpose: Provide the requested 'thin room' ambience without heavy reverb or dark tone.
Final output level adjustment for the FRFR system.

improvements.summary: Replace the current cabinet IR with a more open, jangly 2x12 or single-coil focused IR to better match Rickenbacker/60s pop jangle.

proposals.reason: The current UK Vintage 4x12 is too full; a smaller, brighter cab better captures the Rickenbacker/60s pop chime.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and sparkle in the high end.
